title: THC-Hydra
summary: Fast network login/password-cracking tool maintained by The Hackers Choice.
whyThisMatters: Hydra represents a longstanding class of tools used to assess the resistance of network authentication services. Its dual-use nature makes authorization and rate controls essential.

sections.overview:
THC-Hydra is an open-source network logon testing tool from The Hackers Choice.

Purpose

It supports testing authentication against a range of network protocols and services.

Security teams use such tools to identify weak credentials only in systems they are authorized to assess.

Legacy

Hydra is widely documented in security-testing distributions and illustrates the defensive value and misuse potential of authentication-auditing software.

timeline.event: THC-Hydra is documented as a security tool.
